faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Assistant Engineer (Civil) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Nagpur Assistant Engineer (Civil) recruitment is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with 5 years of experience in design and engineering of civil projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,350/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Assistant Engineer (Civil) job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official AIIMS Nagpur website on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Scrutiny of Application, Document Verification, and Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
